title: Hoshino Ichika — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ichika's birthday
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you all very, very much for gathering here today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And nowー
I'd like to begin the earliest celebration of Ichi's birthday in the whole, wide world!
Clap clap clap♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel a little bad, having you all gather late at night like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're all staying over here tonight anyway, so what's the problem?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, Miku, you have the honors!
Take it away for us♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Are we all ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then... Ichika, let's have as much fun as we can tonight until you start getting sleepy. Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Sakki! You already have the first activity picked out for us, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do! Our first activity is gonna be an interview with Ichika, who just took a step closer to becoming a grown-up!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll be interviewing you.
I have so many questions that I'd like to ask you today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: First, what are your resolutions for this upcoming year? How would you like to spend it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: M-My resolutions? Umm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now that we've gone pro, lots of people have begun listening to our songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm really happy that we've been able to reach so many people through our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it hasn't been all fun and games. We've also seen how we still have a lot of work left ahead of us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I'd like to become a better guitarist, songwriter, performer, everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To make sure that we go above and beyond our listeners' expectations.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I like that...
And I'm sure you'll all blow away any expectations that are thrown at you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That was so cool, Ichi!
You looked all sparkly somehow!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also found your response compelling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, here's my next question...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for answering so many questions for us, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, if anything, I should thank you.
You threw in a few curveballs, which made things really fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like when she asked, “If Miku told you that you could have only the yakisoba or the bun in a yakisoba bun, then which would you choose?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you gave such a great answer, Ichika. I never thought I'd ever hear you say—

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You don't have to repeat it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That ended up being a very exciting interview.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: During all that, we finished prepping this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Prepping what...? Wow!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this a giant yakisoba bun...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we baked a cake which looks like a yakisoba bun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had the idea of using the vermicelli for Mont Blanc cakes for the yakisoba. The color came out really well too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is incredible...!
The way the sauce glistens looks so real!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And the red ginger's... Oh, are these julienned strawberries? You're amazing, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's so excited...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I was actually a little worried since there was no actual yakisoba or bread involved, so thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I made sure to make it as low-sugar as possible since I knew we'd be having this very late at night. So, there's no need to worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona's got all the bases covered!
Anyway, let's start digging in♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is so good!
The flavor is so gentle and soothing, somehow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
And it's not too sweet, either. I could go for another slice or two.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, while we have this cake, let's start giving her our presents♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I got you a Miku plushie!
I thought it was perfect for you, since she looks like she's having so much fun while singing. And just like that, next up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I got you the sleeping version of that same Miku, because I thought she looked really cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, they're both adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ We actually went out and got these with Emu, so there's one more on the way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you'll have to wait to see what Otori got you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I can't wait...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I got you a Phenny charm.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, Phenny's playing the guitar...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I had a feeling that you'd like it, Ichika.
There's also something special about that charm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We recommend attaching it to a certain pouch. Right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you for that pass, Honami.
So, here are the mini pouches that we made for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, you made these?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We made them together after Honami taught us how. She even brought us to a fabric store so we could pick out fabrics and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And here's a little something extra...
It's a lucky charm. I hope you'll accept it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A lucky charm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were originally planning on just making pouches, but Miku decided to use the remaining fabric to make a lucky charm.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We each did one stitch in turn, putting in our hopes that you'll keep on succeeding.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really...?!
These pouches and this charm are so wonderful... I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I just noticed how there are little shooting stars embroidered on these. They looked blank at first glance.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, you noticed!
We worked really hard on those☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks...!
I promise to treasure these, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're glad you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, that's it for birthday presents!
But the night is still young♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, let's start the second half! Are you all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
Yeah!
